parsed.title: Contradictory target-dir fallback
parsed.detail: The 'Needs-input guard' section states 'Cwd is used as a fallback only' for `<target-dir>`, but 'Step 0 — Discover the project' states 'Inspect the target dir ([target-dir], default cwd)'. This creates ambiguity: is CWD a fallback for a missing input (which requires a re-ask/halt per the guard) or a default value (which violates the 'no default' rule)?
